direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge cinematic factory scene to at least 70% of main, side content condensed inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, an x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text only; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow along feasible emerald routes, state glow, depth cues and cinematic 240ms transitions driven by real state change; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; prefers-reduced-motion removes flow, glow pulses and transitions so silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald with living material flow, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; depth and state glow reinforce hierarchy without obscuring text; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; full-shop cascade represents every machine with department depth and affected-operation state

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory SVG to at least 70% of main and give callouts, stations and jobs separate reserved zones so option cards no longer crowd the scene base.
Raise rail and side-zone body text to 16px/24 and header tab labels to at least 16px while keeping the 1366x768 fit.
Add living emerald flow, depth and state glow to feasible routes only, with reduced-motion fallback to pattern, marker and text.
Visually and semantically separate provider-identity readiness from the investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status lines and controls.
Enlarge the scene toward 70% and condense the right zone without scrolling so both numbered tasks remain fully visible at 768px.
Add a clear 2px emerald focus ring and arrow-key rail movement, announcing check results through aria-live polite.
Keep verified findings inside one reserved side zone at 16px body type; tighten disclosure rows so no evidence detail pushes past the viewport.
Link finding rows bidirectionally to SVG nodes with glow on focus and hover, preserving flow only on feasible routes.
Strengthen cinematic depth on the 120 versus 80 tracks while keeping DOES NOT MATCH inside stage bounds.
Make each path row one large selectable target of at least 44px; on selection open the typed consent form rather than implying selection alone records acceptance.
Show 83h/$0, 35h/$3,115 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 with aligned tabular metrics at 16px minimum in the reserved comparison zone.
Preview the selected path as emerald flow through the enlarged SVG before consent, with reduced-motion static highlighting.
Keep proposed tasks explicitly labelled PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL in both scene cards and board zone, with approval as the single primary.
Refit the three task cards into the jobs reserved zone at 16px so due times and Awaiting approval states never compress.
Add state glow to the ready task only and keep dashed silver treatment for dependent tasks.
Retain silver cross-hatching on the previewed CELL-MILL-2 and add the x marker plus plain OFFLINE wording in the applied state, with no route drawn through it.
Enlarge the preview banner and flow scene so 24h to 0h reads as the cinematic focal transition at 240ms, static under reduced motion.
Give the machine selector and Apply second shock targets at least 44px with a visible focus ring.
Make CELL-MILL-2 read as stopped with consistent silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text, and remove any feasible route through it.
Separate provider-identity readiness from the evidence investigation heading, status and primary control as on the earlier investigation step.
Direct emerald living flow only through CELL-MILL-1 feasible capacity and enlarge the SVG to the 70% target.
Keep the constrained Split path hatched and non-selectable with its reason at 16px, while the two feasible paths remain single large selectable targets opening typed consent.
Align finish and incremental metrics in tabular columns and keep Human Decision status in its own reserved zone.
Use glow only on feasible paths and static silver pattern for the constrained path under reduced motion.
Preserve coexistence: blocked prior tasks and the approved revised plan stay distinct while replacement tasks remain PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL.
Condense the blocked list inside its reserved zone at 16px without scrolling, showing count, state marker and first item clearly.
Enlarge OFFLINE CELL-MILL-2 treatment with cross-hatching, x marker and plain text matching the legend.
Keep the three sealed proof cards inside the scene reserved zone and retain 70, 35h and 48h metrics at display size in the side zone.
Add restrained cinematic glow to the seal checks and a 240ms seal transition, fully static under reduced motion.
Raise small evidence labels to at least 12px and action-area body copy to 16px while holding the 768px fit.
Represent every machine across all 7 departments with equal visual weight and department depth; avoid repeating identical affected counts where state data differs.
Replace uniform diagonal striping with legend-led states: emerald feasible flow, silver idle, and silver cross-hatching plus x marker and OFFLINE text for stopped machines.
Enlarge department scenes to fill the viewport, keep metrics at 26px tabular, and make each machine focusable with bidirectional highlighting.
Score judge impact 7: lead the pitch with the recovery outcome and sealed proof, then the human decision, then technical evidence, in that presentation order.
Preserve the official logo in exactly the header and opening-story placements at native aspect, with no extra logo repeats in the pitch.
Enlarge pitch type to 16px minimum and preview the full-shop cascade as the visual climax before the closing proof frame.
